## Description

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At [Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/?utm_campaign=mt_o_m_w_m_m__coi_0_jd-onchain&utm_source=coinbase), we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” [learn more about working at Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/careers).

This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027.

Join the Institutional Operations Solutions (IOS) team within the [Institutional](https://www.coinbase.com/careers/product-groups) group as a Institutional Operations Intern. This team manages risk and delivers operational solutions across Coinbase’s Institutional organization, supporting a broad range of teams and functions that help scale the institutional business. You'll work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders and institutional clients, tackling real operational challenges.

**What you'll do:**

- Support day-to-day IOS operations while identifying and managing operational risk across compliance and regulatory requirements
- Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and risk management capabilities, recommending solutions backed by data analysis
- Partner with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to build technology solutions that support institutional operations at scale
- Analyze data sets and deliver recommendations grounded in sound quantitative reasoning
- Collaborate with fellow interns on a group project solving a real business problem, presenting findings and solutions to the leadership team

**Required Skills and Experience:**

- Currently pursuing a degree or certificate in business, management, finance, accounting, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated problem-solving ability with capacity to identify second-order effects and streamline processes accordingly
- Proven willingness to engage cross-functional stakeholders and collaborate in team settings
- Familiarity with finance or banking concepts, with interest in crypto and digital assets
- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality
